response.justification: Bogdan has strong, broad technical experience (15+ years, senior IC roles, open source, Linux, diverse stacks, some architecture and mentoring via workshops) but the resume shows only 'Basic' German, far below the C1 minimum required for this client-facing leadership role, and he has never held a formal team-lead or engineering-management title, both of which are core to this position.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience across web, embedded, mobile and backend systems
Deep open-source and Linux background, including founding and maintaining his own OSS geo-data platform
Demonstrated communication and teaching ability via workshops, talks, and community initiatives
concerns: German proficiency listed as only 'Basic', well below the required C1 minimum for client advisory work
No formal team-lead, engineering-manager, or head-of-development title in his history, limiting evidence of people leadership
No explicit mention of UML, formal requirements management, or IT security/compliance expertise required for the role

key_factors.factor: Strong technical breadth and open-source/Linux expertise
